activities.name: List
activities.whenToUse: Use with AzureStorageAccount or AzureKeyVault to enumerate blob files/immediate virtual directories or Key Vault secret metadata. Filter/sort/type and virtual-path inputs are provider-specific; Key Vault Directory returns an empty list. Listed LocalFileSystem has no mapped Invoke for List.
activities.description: Enumerate Azure Storage Account blob files or immediate virtual directories, or Azure Key Vault secret metadata. Returns a JSON-compatible PSCustomObject with Items array and Count; each item has FileName, VirtualPath, DateTime (UTC ISO-8601 or null), and Size (bytes or null). Key Vault directories are an empty list.

properties.description: Case-insensitive wildcard on FileName after enumeration; blank or absent matches all.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure blob or Key Vault List, set a case-insensitive FileName wildcard after enumeration. Omit or blank to keep all listed items.

properties.description: DateTime, FileName or Size.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure blob or Key Vault List, choose DateTime, FileName or Size when ordering results by that field matters.

properties.description: Ascending or Descending.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure blob or Key Vault List, choose Ascending or Descending for the selected SortBy order.

properties.description: File or Directory. Blob Directory returns immediate virtual directories; Key Vault Directory returns an empty list.
properties.whenToUse: For List, choose File or Directory. Azure blob Directory lists immediate virtual directories; Key Vault Directory returns an empty list rather than secret folders.

properties.description: Directory prefix for blobs (a trailing slash is added) or raw secret-name prefix for Key Vault.
properties.whenToUse: For List, set the Azure blob directory prefix or Key Vault raw secret-name prefix. Blob handling appends a trailing slash where needed.

properties.description: Use the mapped path synthesized from Container and Resource when Config.VirtualPath is absent; slash-only means the provider root.
properties.whenToUse: For List without Config.VirtualPath, use the mapped top-level path synthesized from Container/Resource. A slash-only path addresses the provider root.

properties.description: Build the mapped path from Container and Resource when Config.VirtualPath is absent.
properties.whenToUse: For List without Config.VirtualPath, supply Resource with Container to form the mapped virtual path.

properties.description: Build the mapped path from Container and Resource when Config.VirtualPath is absent.
properties.whenToUse: For List without Config.VirtualPath, supply Container with Resource to form the mapped virtual path.

activities.name: Read
activities.whenToUse: Use with an implementing slot to retrieve content. Embedded/Azure TargetPath mode writes a file and disables fallback Content; ResultDetail true requires that target. Key Vault non-List dispatch reads operation and secret from Config.VirtualPath and implements only Read. Listed LocalFileSystem lacks mapped Invoke.

properties.description: Check whether target-path configuration is present for storage read.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read, supply Config when selecting TargetPath or other read options. The provider checks whether target-file mode was explicitly requested.

properties.description: Extract Key Vault request configuration and check whether it is present.
properties.whenToUse: For Key Vault non-List dispatch, supply Config.VirtualPath to select its implemented Read operation and secret; Write/Delete/Exists labels do not establish those operations. The provider checks Config presence first.

properties.description: Supply fallback content when reading fails without a target path.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read without TargetPath, supply fallback Content for a failed read when a substitute result is needed. Target-file mode disables this fallback path.

properties.description: Select the Azure upload content type.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure upload or fallback write, set ContentType when the stored content needs an explicit media type.

properties.description: Choose an Azure upload path suffix.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure upload or fallback write, set PathSuffix when targeting a suffixed blob path.

properties.description: Reject HTTP-status-only output when reading to a target file.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure Read with TargetPath, leave ReturnHttpStatus false or absent. Status-only output is rejected for target-file transfer.

properties.description: Persist fallback content through a cloned Write invocation.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read fallback content, set SaveIfNew when that fallback should be persisted through a cloned Write invocation; omit/false to avoid that write.

properties.description: Choose the signal severity for storage operations.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure storage operations, choose SignalLevel when the emitted operation severity needs adjustment.

properties.description: Choose a source file for the storage write.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure write paths, set SourcePath when content should be read from a source file rather than only supplied in Config.Content.

properties.description: Use the legacy misspelled Azure source-file configuration as a fallback.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure write paths, use the legacy misspelled SourthPath only when the supported SourcePath is unavailable and compatibility requires that fallback.

properties.description: Select an explicit destination path and disable fallback content handling when supplied.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read, set an explicit TargetPath only when content should be transferred to a destination file. Its presence disables fallback Content handling.

properties.description: Optional native Boolean, default false. With Read and TargetPath, true returns facts measured from the completed target file; other types and true without TargetPath fail before transfer.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read with TargetPath, set native Boolean ResultDetail true when facts measured from the completed target file are needed. Omit/false for ordinary output; true without TargetPath or a non-Boolean value fails before transfer.

properties.description: Check for an explicit virtual path before synthesizing the top-level storage path.
properties.whenToUse: Set Config.VirtualPath only for providers that read it directly. Mapped dispatch checks whether it has a Result and skips Container/Resource synthesis, but does not copy it to top-level VirtualPath. Embedded reads top-level VirtualPath, so this Config field alone does not route Embedded.

properties.description: Resolve the Azure blob path, falling back to the top-level virtual path if blank.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure blob operations, set Config.VirtualPath for the blob path. Blank value falls back to the preserved top-level virtual path.

properties.description: Select the Key Vault operation and secret from the virtual-path segments.
properties.whenToUse: For Key Vault non-List dispatch, set Config.VirtualPath segment 2 to Read and segment 3 to the secret. It overwrites the supplied activity and only implements Read; List has its separate branch.

properties.description: Build the generated virtual path from the container and resource.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath is absent, supply Container with Resource so mapped dispatch synthesizes top-level VirtualPath for providers that consume it. Key Vault non-List still reads Config.VirtualPath; LocalFileSystem lacks mapped Invoke.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning fallback content for a storage write.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read fallback write cloning, retain incoming Phase to preserve conduction context in the cloned plan.

properties.description: Preserve the original conduction context reference while cloning the plan for a Key Vault read.
properties.whenToUse: For Key Vault request cloning, retain incoming Phase so original conduction context is preserved.

properties.description: Preserve conduction context while cloning fallback content for a storage write.
properties.whenToUse: For Embedded/Azure Read fallback write cloning, retain incoming Plan to preserve conduction context in the cloned plan.

properties.description: Preserve the original conduction context reference while cloning the plan for a Key Vault read.
properties.whenToUse: For Key Vault request cloning, retain incoming Plan so original conduction context is preserved.

properties.description: Build the generated virtual path from the container and resource.
properties.whenToUse: When Config.VirtualPath is absent, supply Resource with Container to synthesize top-level VirtualPath for providers that consume it. Key Vault non-List needs Config.VirtualPath directly; LocalFileSystem lacks mapped Invoke.

properties.description: Read a caller-supplied top-level embedded storage path when mapped dispatch has not replaced it.
properties.whenToUse: For EmbeddedFileSystem, supply or retain top-level VirtualPath as the path it actually reads. Mapped dispatch synthesizes that field from Container/Resource only when Config.VirtualPath has no Result; it never copies Config.VirtualPath to this top-level field.

properties.description: Use a preserved caller top-level path when the explicit Azure virtual path is blank.
properties.whenToUse: For Azure blob operations, retain a caller top-level VirtualPath when blank Config.VirtualPath should fall back to it.

result.description: raw file text [provider-returned]. When resolved local VirtualPath; optional TargetPath or Config.Content fallback; file exists; no TargetPath.
target path [computed]. When resolved local VirtualPath and TargetPath provided with Config.ResultDetail absent or false; copy succeeds.

Uppercase SHA256 of actual completed local target bytes [measured]. When Config.TargetPath and native Boolean Config.ResultDetail=true on Storage_EmbeddedFileSystem.Read.
When resolved local VirtualPath; optional TargetPath or Config.Content fallback; file missing and Config.Content supplied.
When blob VirtualPath and container/address; optional TargetPath or Config.Content fallback; GET succeeds without TargetPath.
local target path [computed]. When blob VirtualPath and container/address; GET downloads to TargetPath with Config.ResultDetail absent or false.
Resolved completed download target path [computed]. When Config.TargetPath and native Boolean Config.ResultDetail=true on Storage_AzureStorageAccount.Read.
Byte count read from the completed download target [measured]. When Config.TargetPath and native Boolean Config.ResultDetail=true on Storage_AzureStorageAccount.Read.
Uppercase SHA256 of actual completed download target bytes [measured]. When Config.TargetPath and native Boolean Config.ResultDetail=true on Storage_AzureStorageAccount.Read.
When blob VirtualPath and container/address; optional TargetPath or Config.Content fallback; missing blob with Config.Content fallback.
When Config.VirtualPath names secret; REST GET; GET response has value.
